2:7c|The project (doc, checked out at an old commit) has this issue:
3:00|
4:c4|Methods decorated with @classmethod and @property do not get documented.
5:ea|**EDIT:** The problem seems to be that `type(BaseClass.baseclass_property)` returns `property`, thus sphinx can just lookup `BaseClass.baseclass_property.__doc__`. However, `type(BaseClass.baseclass_class_property)` returns the type of the returned object, since essentially, a `@classmethod@property` ends up behaving like a class attribute. So Sphinx doesn't really have a chance to extract the docstring.
6:00|
7:06|**EDIT 2:** Seems like this will get fixed in python 3.10, cf. https://bugs.python.org/issue43682.

16:00|
